chunks: Whoever is patient during a calamity, Allah will compensate him.

key_terms.الرَّزِيَّةِ: a calamity, affliction, or distressing loss
key_terms.يَصْبِرْ: to remain patient and steadfast in hardship
key_terms.يُعَوِّضْهُ اللَّهُ: Allah grants him compensation or recompense

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم teach about patience during calamities?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that patience in the face of calamity is met with divine compensation from Allah. It encourages believers to endure hardship with sabr, trusting in Allah’s justice and mercy.
